about: Read notes.md and tell me the release day. Don't run commands. / /compact / Without reading anything, which day did notes.md name? A turn, a manual compaction, then a turn that leans on the summary.

uncited.reason: Codex 0.150.0 saves no id for the compaction: its rollout keeps a compacted record naming context windows and a bare event_msg context_compacted, while live the app-server names the contextCompaction item by an id the rollout never holds. From 0.159.3 the rollout records the item as event_msg item_completed ContextCompaction, and saved history cites it.
